text:
Type: flatwoven hallway runner rug
Use: covering walkways, softening floors; hallway, entryway, kitchen, beside the bed
Style: minimalist, rustic, contemporary
Materials: tightly flatwoven sisal-look fiber, fabric-bound edges
Colors: dark brown, chocolate brown edging
Shape: long narrow runner, flat tight weave, solid tone, neat bound border, low and slim
Feel: grounded, warm, understated, practical
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, oak or walnut furniture; hallways, entryways, rustic or minimalist homes

product.name: OSTED
product.description: The rug is hard-wearing and durable because its made of sisal, a natural fibre taken from the agave plant.
